title: Library Publications
bodyHtml:
The IPC Library also regularly publishes its publications for the scientists/officers, staff, healthcare professionals and researchers to support Research & Development and other official work in the organization to enhance the professional knowledge of the users. The list of Publications is as follows:

  • Accession list of books
  • Article Alert of Journal’s
  • Current Content of Books
  • Current Holdings
  • Indexing & Abstracting of Journals
  • Library Catalogue
